A state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and non-prolonged, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and non-prolonged by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and non-prolonged, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and non-obstructive by way of root condition … [and so on] … six.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, impinging, and not a refuge, there arises a state that is non-visible,

impinging, and not a refuge, by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is non-visible, impinging, and not a refuge, there arises a state that is non-non-visible, impinging, and not a refuge,
by way of root condition … (six combinations) … pe … six.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not a refuge, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not a refuge, by way of root condition … six.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, reacting, and not a refuge, and a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not a refuge, there arises a state that is non-visible, reacting, and not a refuge, by way of root condition … six.

Dependent on a state that is non-obstructive, non-visible, with resistance, and non-secure, and dependent on a state that is non-obstructive, non-visible, without resistance, and non-secure, there arises a state that is non-obstructive, non-visible, with resistance, and non-secure by way of root condition ... [six]. Under root condition there are thirty; under object condition there are nine ... pe ...
under mutuality condition there are twenty-five ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are thirty. (The full detail applies everywhere.

Dependent on a state that is non-obstructive, non-visible, without resistance, and non-secure, [there arises] a state that is non-obstructive, non-visible, with resistance, and non-secure ... [and so forth].

A state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and non-obstructive, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and non-obstructive by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and non-obstructive, there arise states that are both non-visible, non-reacting, and non-obstructive and non-visible, non-reacting, and non-obstructive by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is not visible, not impinging, and not obscure, there arises a state that is not visible, not impinging, and not obscure, by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is not visible, not impinging, and not obscure, there arises a state that is not invisible, not impinging, and not obscure, by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is not visible, not impinging, and not obscure...
Dhammas that are non-visible, non-reactive, and non-obscured arise by way of the root condition.

Dependent on dhammas that are both non-visible, non-reactive, and non-obscured, and those that are non-non-visible, non-reactive, and non-obscured, a dhamma that is non-visible, non-reactive, and non-obscured arises by way of the root condition. [Dependent on] a dhamma that is non-visible, non-reactive, and non-obscured...
Dependent on a state that is non-obscured, non-visible, and non-reactive, and dependent on a state that is non-obscured, non-visible, and non-reactive,
there arises a state that is non-obscured, non-visible, and non-reactive by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).

Dependent on a state that is non-obscured, non-visible, and non-reactive, and dependent on a state that is non-obscured, non-visible, and non-reactive, there arises [a state] that is non-obscured, non-visible, and non-reactive, and [a state] that is non-obscured, non-visible, and non-reactive...
And non-material phenomena arise with material phenomena as their cause-condition. (Abbreviated.

Under the cause-condition there are nine; under the object-condition there are nine … pe … under the non-disappearance-condition there are nine. (In the co-nascence section, the condition section, the dependence section, the conjoined section, and the associated section—in all cases there are nine.)
